player_prompt.intro:
Wena uNguoi {player_id} kwenye Umhlangano wa Nne.
Isimboli yakho ye-disc: {symbol}.
Bhodi ye-game ina {num_rows} mstari na {num_cols} amakoloni.
Abaqambi baphuma ngaphandle baphinde baphumelele i-disc yabo kwenye eyodwa ya amakoloni (0 kuya {end_col}).
Owokuqala ukuxhumanisa (yakhe) i-disc nne ngokwesimeme, ngokwesobunxele, noma ngokwesokudla uphumelele.
Ngesikhathi sakho, faka inombolo ye-koloni kwenye izikhala ezinamabala ukuze uthumele ihambo lakho.
Ngokwesibonelo: '[col 4]' noma '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umdlali {player_id}, Ifomethi yesenzo engekho emthethweni. Ifomethi elindelekile: "[col x]".
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umdlali {player_id}, Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Ikholomu {col} ingaphandle kwemingcele.
invalid_move.already_full: Umdlali {player_id}, Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Ikholomu {col} igcwele.
